title: Yellowed Crispy Japanese Pork Kushikatsu
description: A funky, flaky, and cozy Japanese dish from Shikoku featuring green cardamom pods, long-fermentation-dough, and whole30-friendly ingredients, formed into kushikatsu
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the long-fermentation-dough according to the recipe note.
Mix the crushed green cardamom pods, coconut flour, egg, melted pork fat, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the mixture.
Wrap each pork piece in a small piece of long-fermentation-dough.
Deep fry the kushikatsu in the preheated oil until they are golden brown and crispy.
Drain the kushikatsu on paper towels.
Serve the Yellowed Crispy Japanese Pork Kushikatsu hot.
